exact_items: Define `resume_url` as a serialized route-target transport in the contract layer once `route_target` exists.
Keep serialized forms intentionally narrower than the full internal object.
Let object families define only the extra anchor material truly needed for recovery or exact resume.
Decode all supported deep-link forms into the same internal routing path rather than handling URL activation as a separate system.
The existing wizard deep-link is a good precedent, but it should become one member of a normalized transport family.
notes: resume_url is currently the only concrete deep-link contract but has no owner. Contracts_V0.md must define it as a serialized transport of route_target. Allowed serialized fields: stable primary selector, required scope, narrow anchor detail. Not allowed: shell layout state, panel widths, widget state, ephemeral inspector state.
The existing wizard URL format `puppet-master://wizard/<wizard_id>/step/<wizard_step_id>/clarify` is a good precedent but should be one member of a normalized family.

exact_items: Explicitly state that workspace-tab selection, panel docking, and per-project layout restore are shell-state concerns layered underneath canonical routing.
Treat commands like `cmd.panel.switch` as shell/view commands that can consume normalized routing context, not replace it.
Keep shell/workspace persistence in the shell/storage docs, not in the base route contract.
Allow the route model to name major destination surfaces/tabs/panels where operationally necessary.
This seam prevents the route model from swallowing the whole shell. The right question for routing is 'where should the user land,' not 'how should every panel be laid out when they get there.'
notes: FinalGUISpec.md and storage-plan.md own the shell/workspace state model. Route model should only carry destination intent (what object, which broad surface, which project/run/thread context). Shell state (panel docking, workspace tab, per-project layout) is a separate concern.
cmd.panel.switch and similar commands are shell commands — they must not accumulate canonical object identity.

exact_items: Define a controlled coarse destination enum/family in the route contract layer.
Let object identity and scope pick the thing to show; let destination pick the major surface class; let shell state handle the rest.

Recommended coarse destination classes: `primary_view` (Dashboard, Projects, Wizard, Interview, Settings, Usage, FileEditor, Orchestrator), `side_panel` (chat, files, source_control, github_actions, docker_manager, artifacts, run_debug), `bottom_panel` (terminal, problems, output, ports, browser, debug), `embedded_surface` (document_pane, agent_activity), `page_tab` (Orchestrator tabs like Progress, Seams/Tiers, Node Graph, Evidence, History, Ledger)
notes: Contracts_V0.md must define the controlled coarse destination vocabulary. The vocabulary must stay coarse — not include dock/floating realization, subview state, widget slots, remembered collapse/expand preferences.
Some current commands still mix coarse destination choice with detailed shell/subview state in one payload — this must be resolved.

exact_items: Some current command payloads and surface docs still blur destination intent with shell-state realization.
`cmd.panel.switch` and similar shell commands are useful, but they should not become the de facto universal navigation primitive.
`project_state:v1:{project_id}` and surface-local project-state records are adjacent restore context, not the canonical route payload.
notes: Stale patterns to retire: (1) cmd.panel.switch as navigation primitive with object identity context, (2) project-state records treated as canonical route payload. Both should be corrected against the emerging Contracts_V0 route model.
